description: Bank-neutral enterprise IT operations SOP and FAQ extensions. Replace contacts and source links with approved institution metadata before production use.

records.title: SafeWord token locked after failed attempts
records.answer: If a SafeWord token is locked, stop retrying OTP values. Verify the user identity and token serial in IAM, then use the approved token unlock or re-enrollment process. If self-service recovery fails, raise a CMP request to IAM Operations with the error time and token status.
procedure: Verify identity and token serial
Check lock status in IAM
Use approved unlock or re-enrollment
Raise CMP to IAM Operations if recovery fails
records.approval: Replacement tokens require manager approval and identity verification.

records.title: CMP request information checklist
records.answer: A useful CMP request includes the application and environment, user ID, exact error, timestamp, business impact, screenshots or sanitized logs, requested completion date, and the affected support queue.
procedure: Select the correct CMP catalog item
Describe the issue and business impact
Attach sanitized evidence
Add required-by date
Submit to the application support queue
Record the CMP number
records.approval: Access, production, and change requests follow the application owner's approval route.

records.title: Who is the application approval POC
records.answer: Use the service catalog to identify the application owner and technical support queue. The line manager is the normal first approver; privileged or production access also requires application-owner approval and may require control-owner approval.
procedure: Search the service catalog by application and environment
Identify the application owner
Obtain line-manager approval
Obtain application-owner approval for privileged or production access
records.approval: Never bypass the approval chain; confirm the required approvers in the current service catalog record.

records.title: Application installation not available in software catalog
records.answer: Install only from the managed software catalog. If the package is missing, do not use a public download link; raise a CMP service request with the application name, business justification, device ID, operating system, and required-by date.
procedure: Search the managed software catalog
Confirm the approved package and version
Raise CMP if the package is absent
Wait for endpoint approval before elevated installation
records.approval: Elevated installation requires endpoint-admin approval and approved software validation.

records.title: Application issue triage questions
records.answer: Before raising a ticket, capture what the user was trying to do, the application and environment, exact error text, timestamp and timezone, frequency, recent changes, business impact, and whether other users are affected.
procedure: Capture exact error and timestamp
Confirm application and environment
Check whether the issue affects other users
Retry only the documented safe step
Raise CMP with sanitized evidence if unresolved
records.approval: The support queue determines whether owner, change, or emergency approval is required.
